g.title: j3854565692
g.text: Do you have a moment? I’m a bit upset about something and I could use a friendly ear. Or maybe a bit of a telling off. I’m not sure yet.

g.title: j3335512506
g.text: Because Kaya says I am. And I had one of those ‘oh shit’ moments when you look back on all the conversations you’ve had with someone and you suddenly see yourself in a new light.

g.title: j1082226677
g.text: I think I know what she meant, yeah. Sorry, but she's right.

g.title: j1359560726
g.text: Yes. She just dropped it into the middle of a chat we were having. 'You're cool but you're a minefield. I never know how you're going to react to anything.'

g.title: j1103198437
g.text: Glad to hear it. Thank you.

g.title: j1574070519
g.text: I'm glad Kaya called you out on it. I've said things here I thought were harmless and you've reacted like I set your hair on fire.

g.title: j3400598714
g.text: You have really extreme reactions sometimes. They're out of proportion to what I've said to you.

g.title: j1917762026
g.text: It's like you leap straight to the worst possible interpretation of what I might have meant.

g.title: j2058799613
g.text: Sometimes you just quit the conversation entirely and I don't even get a chance to explain myself.

g.title: j2396731814
g.text: Right now I feel like logging the hell off and never using KIM again.

g.title: j2973824844
g.text: Maybe think about what you just said there?

g.title: j2667627583
g.text: I think you need some time to think about that. [END.]

g.title: j3708767767
g.text: I'm telepathic. Didn't ask to be. But I am. I pick up on thoughts.

g.title: j1166769242
g.text: If we're talking face to face then I have all sorts of cues that tell me what you're feeling

g.title: j776307128
g.text: expression, body language, and hey sometimes an actual THOUGHT because, like I said, TELEPATH

g.title: j1942174948
g.text: but here on KIM I have to guess and there are no clues

g.title: j3452718077
g.text: and so yes, I kneejerk sometimes.

g.title: j4053449967
g.text: (deep breath, sit up straight, get it together Eleanor)

g.title: j3247832740
g.text: I will try my best not to be a minefield in future.

g.title: j3889108971
g.text: And I'll have a look back through our old chats and have a good long think.

g.title: j1599611503
g.text: I owe you that. Because minefield or not, you're still here. You kept walking. x
